title: How much reaches the hawk?
hook: A field of plants feeds a chain of animals. What is left by the top?

knows: animals eat plants or other animals
doesNotKnow: that only a small share of energy passes up each link

misconception: Energy passes up a food chain largely intact, so a top predator could be as plentiful as the animals it ultimately depends on.
objective: The learner can explain that each link passes on only about a tenth of the energy, so energy at the top of a chain of n links is about 10^-n of the plants' and top predators are scarce.

claims.text: With 10,000 units in plants and 10% passed on per link, four links give 1,000, 100, 10 and about 1 unit for the hawks.
Most of the energy at each level is not passed on: it is used for living and given off as heat, or it is never eaten or digested.
claims.source: Lindeman, R. L. (1942), 'The trophic-dynamic aspect of ecology', Ecology 23(4): 399-418; Begon, Townsend & Harper, Ecology: From Individuals to Ecosystems (Blackwell), chapter on the flux of energy through ecosystems.

claims.text: Because so little energy passes up each link, food chains are short and top predators are scarce.
claims.source: Elton, C. (1927), Animal Ecology (pyramid of numbers); Begon, Townsend & Harper, Ecology, chapter on the flux of energy (why food chains are short).

claims.text: 10% is a rule of thumb; measured transfer efficiencies range roughly from 5 to 20%.
claims.source: Pauly, D. & Christensen, V. (1995), 'Primary production required to sustain global fisheries', Nature 374: 255-257 (mean about 10% in aquatic food webs, wide spread); Lindeman (1942).

claims.text: At 20% per link the hawks would get 16 units; at 5%, 0.06.
On the stage each square's area is proportional to its energy; the chain and the numbers are made up.
claims.source: Drawing choice in Demo.tsx (side = 140 x sqrt(E / 10,000)).

recall.question: Plants in a lake hold 1,000,000 units of energy, and about 10% passes up each link. How much reaches an animal three links above the plants?
recall.why: Three links keep 0.1 x 0.1 x 0.1 = 1/1,000 of the energy: 1,000,000 / 1,000 = 1,000 units.
